title: The Love Hypothesis
author: Ali Hazelwood
description: Olive, a Stanford PhD student, pretends to date the notoriously intimidating professor Adam Carlsen to convince her best friend that she has moved on. The longer the act goes on, the harder it gets to tell what's real and what's just for show.

title: Better Than the Movies
author: Lynn Painter
description: Liz is a devoted rom-com fan who wants her own movie-worthy love story with her longtime crush before prom. She teams up with Wes, her next-door neighbor and childhood nemesis, but the real romance may be closer to home than she thinks.

title: Book Lovers
author: Emily Henry
description: Nora is a sharp, workaholic literary agent who always ends up as the "other woman" in everyone else's love stories. When a trip to a small town with her sister Libby brings her face to face with a rival editor, her story starts to take an unexpected turn.

title: Tress of the Emerald Sea
author: Brandon Sanderson
description: Tress leads a quiet life on her island until her friend Charlie is swept away on a dangerous voyage. She stows away on a ship and crosses a deadly sea to find the Sorceress who can help save him.

title: The Starless Sea
author: Erin Morgenstern
description: Zachary finds a mysterious book that seems strangely connected to his own life. Following it leads him to a hidden underground world filled with stories, secrets, and endless books.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: Alicia, a famous painter, murdered her husband and hasn't spoken a word since. Theo, a psychotherapist, is determined to uncover the truth behind her silence.

title: The Da Vinci Code
author: Dan Brown
description: After the murder of a Louvre curator, symbologist Robert Langdon and cryptologist Sophie Neveu race through a trail of codes and clues. Each one brings them closer to a long-buried secret tied to religious history.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
description: Reclusive Hollywood icon Evelyn Hugo chooses young journalist Monique Grant to write her life story. Through each marriage and sacrifice, the truth behind the glamour slowly comes out.

title: Yellowface
author: R. F. Kuang
description: June, a struggling author, takes the unpublished manuscript of her recently deceased acquaintance and publishes it as her own. Her success comes quickly, but so does the fear of being exposed.
